_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Life Wasted (Pearl Jam, Pearl Jam 2006).

title: Life Wasted
content:
{section: Intro}
[F#5] [C#5]   [E5] [B5] (x2)

{section: Verso 1}
[F#5] [C#5]                                [E5]      [B5]
    You're always saying that there's something wrong
[F#5] [C#5]                      [E5]               [B5]
    I'm starting to believe it's your plan all along
[F#5] [C#5]                         [E5]       [B5]
    Death came around, forced to hear its song
[F#5] [C#5]                        [E5]      [B5]
    And know tomorrow can't be depended on

{section: Interlúdio 1}
[E]            [Emaj7]
  I seen the home inside your head
[E]          [Emaj7]
All locked doors and unmade beds
[E]      [Emaj7]
  Open sores unattended
[E]      [Emaj7]
Let me say just once that

{section: Refrão}
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    I have faced it,   a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    I escaped it,       a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    Having tasted,     a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again

{section: Interlúdio 2}
[E]           [Emaj7]
  The world awaits just up the stairs
[E]         [Emaj7]
Leave the pain for someone else
[E]         [Emaj7]
  Nothing back there for you to find
[E]         [Emaj7]
Or was it you, you left behind?

{section: Solo}
[F#5] [C#5]   [E5] [B5] (x4)

{section: Verso 2}
[F#5] [C#5]                           [E5]       [B5]
    You're always saying you're too weak to be strong
[F#5] [C#5]                            [E5]     [B5]
    You're harder on yourself than just about anyone
[F#5] [C#5]                          [E5]     [B5]
    Why swim the channel just to get this far?
[F#5] [C#5]                     [E5]    [B5]
    Halfway there, why would you turn around?

[A]            [E]                   [A]              [E]
  Darkness comes in waves, tell me why invite it to stay?
        [A]
You're warm with negativity
     [E]             [A]
Yes, comfort is an energy
        [E]
But why let the sad song play?

{section: Refrão 2}
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    I have faced it,   a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    I escaped it,       a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    Having tasted,     a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again
[F#5] [C#5]            [F#5] [C#5]
    Oh I erased it,    a life wasted
[F#5] [C#5]             [B5]
    I'm never going back again

{section: Outro}
[F#5] [C#5]   [E5] [B5] (mesmo que intro, até fadeout)
